maple.name: Maple
inside: Welcome in! Seeds are on the left, snacks on the right, gossip's free.
Gideon says my prices are robbery. Gideon charges forty crystals for a nail.
Don't lean on the glass case, dear.

perks.2: 5% off at the Mercantile
perks.4: 10% off; Maple stocks rare seeds
perks.6: Maple sends a seed pack each season
perks.8: 20% off at the Mercantile
perks.10: Maple gifts a Golden Watering Can's worth of growth: 3 Growth Elixirs

gideon.name: Gideon
inside: Iron. Steel. Don't touch the forge.
Bring me ore and I'll make you something that doesn't bend.
Wooden sword. Hm. You'll want better before the mountain.

perks.2: Tool upgrades 10% cheaper
perks.4: Tool upgrades 20% cheaper
perks.6: Gideon forges you a free Copper Ring
perks.8: Upgrades 30% cheaper
perks.10: Gideon's last lesson: +20 max health

wren.name: Wren
inside: Careful, that one bites. The purple one. No, the OTHER purple one.
Red for hurts, tea for tired. Say it back to me.
The crystal talks to you? Interesting. Does it talk to anyone else?

perks.2: Potions heal 25% more
perks.4: Wren leaves Energy Tea on your step each week
perks.6: Wren brews you a free potion each week
perks.8: Potions heal 50% more
perks.10: Wren teaches you to hold more magic: +20 max mana

alder.name: Mayor Alder
inside: Have a seat, have a seat. Mind the papers. Those are important. Probably.
The town's doing well. The town is always doing well. That's my job.
If you need the board, the board meets when I say it meets.

perks.2: Town records: the mayor sends a Map Scrap
perks.4: Permits and buildings 20% cheaper
perks.6: A building grant: ◆500 toward your next plans
perks.8: Alder lends you the town cart (sell box pays 10% more)
perks.10: Keys to the city: ◆500 from the town purse

perks.2: Sal tells you where the loot is: a Map Scrap and a Luck Potion
perks.4: Sal teaches you to walk quiet: enemies notice you later
perks.6: Sal's spare kit: 2 Greater Potions
perks.8: Sal's contacts slip you ◆300
perks.10: Sal's old charm: a Dream Charm

perks.2: Fish bite 10% sooner

perks.6: Finn's secret spot: a Luck Potion for the big ones
perks.8: +10% chance of a rare fish
perks.10: Finn's lucky tin: 3 Luck Potions

perks.2: Lumi gives you paints for your sign
perks.4: Lumi sells you paints at cost: 3 Paint each week
perks.6: A portrait of you hangs in the hall (+10 max energy, you feel proud)
perks.8: Lumi teaches you to see: +10 max energy
perks.10: Lumi paints the Dream mural: a Dream Charm

theo.name: Theo
inside: Shh. Well, not shh. But quietly.
There's a book here about the valley that nobody's finished. Chapter one is enough to keep you up.
Lumi draws in the margins. I pretend not to notice.

perks.2: +5% skill XP
perks.4: Theo lends you books: +10% skill XP
perks.6: Theo translates the ruin stones: 2 Memory Teas
perks.8: +15% skill XP
perks.10: Theo's thesis: one free skill point in every tree

perks.2: Hazel shares seeds: a seed pack each week
perks.4: Hazel waters your crops every other day
perks.6: Hazel waters your crops every day
perks.8: Hazel harvests ripe crops into your sell box
perks.10: Hazel's heirloom seeds: 5 Dream Seeds

bram.name: Bram
inside: Stew's on. Sit anywhere that isn't the mayor's chair.
Heard a story about a farmer and a crystal. Didn't believe it. Then you walked in.
Rooms upstairs if the walk home's too long. First night's free, second night's a pie.

perks.2: Bram's breakfast: a Tea each week
perks.4: Free soup at the inn: +30 energy once a day
perks.6: Bram's pies: 2 Orchard Pies
perks.8: Bram's stories: a Map Scrap
perks.10: Bram names a dish after you (+50 max energy)

posy.name: Posy
inside: Fresh out of the oven! Mind your fingers.
Bring me wheat and I'll bring you bread. Bring me strawberries and I'll bring you cake.
Maple says you're clearing that old field. Good. Somebody should.

perks.2: A free loaf every morning
perks.4: Posy bakes for you: a Berry Pie each week
perks.6: Posy's recipes: 2 Cakes
perks.8: Festival cake: +20 max energy
perks.10: Posy's best: two berry pies each week

juniper.name: Juniper
inside: Sit. Let me look at that.
You've been swinging a sword in the meadow, haven't you. I can always tell.
Eat something green once in a while. I mean it.

perks.2: Clinic fee halved
perks.4: Juniper's tonic: +20 max health
perks.6: Clinic fee waived
perks.8: Juniper visits: wake with full energy after a collapse
perks.10: Juniper teaches Second Wind: +30 max health

rook.name: Rook
inside: Tracks by the stream. Big ones.
Don't go in the forest after dark without a lantern. Or do. I'll come and find you in the morning.

perks.2: Rook shows tracks: a Pelt each week
perks.4: Rook sells arrows and traps
perks.6: Rook's map of the quarry path: a Map Scrap
perks.8: Rook's field kit: 2 Greater Potions, and a keepsake for your home: Country Oak Painting
perks.10: Rook's lucky arrowhead: a Light Charm

pip.name: Pip
lines: I'm not allowed in the forest. Are you?

perks.6: Pip's secret: the fountain wish works (a Luck Potion)

lines: Heart at the chest. Hearts and paws. Remember.
The cats say hello. Your dog is not impressed; dogs never are.

perks.4: Catkins' four coats: +10 max mana
perks.6: Cat-topia's pantry: 2 Tuna each week
perks.8: A guardian's patience: +20 max mana, and a keepsake for your home: Golden Lucky Cat
perks.10: Catkins' monastery blessing: +20 max health

tess.name: Tess
inside: Measure twice, cut once. Then sand it till it purrs.
Every chair in this town has a wobble I know by name.
Bring me a room and a budget. I'll bring the rest.

perks.2: Tess saves you offcuts: 5 Wood each week
perks.4: Tess's spare planks: 10 Plank
perks.6: Tess sends hardwood: 3 Hardwood each week
perks.10: Tess's master joinery: 10 Hardwood
